changes.text: New Raid Zone: The Labyrinth of Fog 🐄
New Story Arc: Ashling Corlett - 'Only Love Can Hurt Like This' 💙
New Powerset: Marine Affinity 🌊
Enemy Group Revamp: The Warriors ⚔️
New Power Customization Options
New Left/Right Eye Auras
New Aether Shop Rewards + WST Aether at all levels
New Pocket D Friend: Blarf
New vanity pet recipe drops
New Badges; Four New Accolades + Powers
Numerous bug fixes and improvements

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: This new co-op raid zone is accessed via an artifact cube found in the Midnighter Club.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: All players are automatically set to Level 50 while in the zone.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: An info NPC ghost found near the zone's entrance provides additional information on the specifics of the zone.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: A trainer, merit vendor, nurse, and buff crafting station have been added to the Midnighter Club zone to help facilitate adventuring activities within the Labyrinth of Fog.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The Midnighter Club has been added to Long Range Teleport unlocked by owning the 'Midnight Squad' badge.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The Labyrinth of Fog added to the LFG queue where it's found under the 'Trials & Raids' tab if you can access the Midnighter Club and are over Level 45.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The zone has a 50-player population cap. Additional instances will generate if one fills.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The raid zone begins with the labyrinth's entrance lobby.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Reviving at the hospital while in this zone will return you to the entrance lobby.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Idle players are returned to the Midnighter Club after 15 minutes of inactivity.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Logging out while in the zone will return you to the entrance lobby upon login.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: There is no mini map in the labyrinth except for the entrance lobby.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The entrance lobby contains four color-coded portals that each are used to enter into the labyrinth.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Each goes to a color-coded floor. There are six floor colors total: Red, Yellow, Blue, Green, Violet, Orange

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The color of the floor determines what set of grouped enemies populate that floor.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Violet Floors contain the most dangerous groups and Giant Monster event channel spawns.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Orange floors contain completely randomized enemies.

changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: Labyrinth of Fog is an extremely vast (40+ floors) mission-style zone filled with Level 54+1 enemies to battle for increased rewards.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: It is intended this zone be tackled with a Team or League.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: All enemies in the zone are Rank Shifted (Minion -> Lieutenant, etc.) up to a maximum rank of Elite Boss.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: Enemies behave identically to standard content and drop all the same rewards they would normally.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: As Elite Bosses are defeated, a meter on your navigation will fill up, eventually granting a zone-wide Level Shift buff!

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: Elite Bosses have a foggy aura to make them easier to identify as the targets in the zone.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: Elite Bosses increase in Level Shifts alongside the players.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: Pets (including Mastermind and Lore) also receive the zone-wide Level Shift buffs.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: While in The Labyrinth of Fog, players are hunted continuously by The Minotaur In The Fog, a Monster that's Level 54+(5 to 10) and periodically (every 2-3 minutes) moves to the location of a player on the map (higher odds for the zone's oldest occupants, excludes those in the entrance lobby which is always safe), navigating the labyrinth's maze at inhuman speeds to find prey.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: For every 8 players in the zone after the first, the Minotaur will gain another +1 Level Shift (min +5, max +10).

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: The navigation window will display the Minotaur's current level, or, if they're currently dead, will show a timer to their next respawn time:

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: Defeating the Minotaur will award the new 'Slayer of the Minotaur' badge and the Minotaur will vanish from the zone for one hour, allowing people to adventure and battle enemies within without danger.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: The Minotaur rewards a choice table with 5 Prismatic Aether + 10 Monstrous Aether to all who participated in the defeat on an 18 hour cool-down. Additional defeats within that time will only reward half the payout.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: Alternatively, can select 3 Draught of Fog inspirations with no cool-down.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: The Minotaur will spawn with one of five different weapon power sets; All weapon powers deal 100% Negative Energy damage exclusively.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: Fight For Rewards & Gain Level Shifts!
changes.text: All variants of the Minotaur come with the Unholy Plague Howl, Netted Pilums, Hoof Stomp, Trial By Combat, and Fog Given Form powers.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Special 'Malevolent Fog' pinata enemies (no attacks, no regeneration) can be found in the labyrinth that, when defeated, increases the zone's Level Shift navigation bar meter by 50 points and grants 1 Reward Merit to all players in the zone who meet the following conditions:

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Cannot be dead.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Cannot be in the entrance lobby, the Core, or a secret area.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: A single player who participated in the defeat will receive a 'Draught of Fog' inspiration.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: These special inspirations provide the user with 15 minutes of a single Level Shift stack exclusive to them and their pets, as well as immunity to the Diseased debuff.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: These Inspirations are not bound and can be freely traded or stored in Super Group bases.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Malevolent Fog are most commonly found in rooms that are dead ends, and their FX makes them stands out in the foggy environment.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Once defeated, another Malevolent Fog will spawn somewhere else in the labyrinth to take its place. This should naturally filter them down to lesser visited places over time while ensuring there is always some to be found.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The zone-wide buff grants +1 Level Shift, +DMG/ToHit/Recharge/Recovery for each stack. It can be stacked up to ten times from either Malevolent Fog defeats or cumulative Elite Boss defeats. The current Level Shift total can be seen on your buff bar as a black icon with a white number:

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: The Labyrinth's Level Shifts stack up to a max of 10!
changes.text: The Level Shift buffs decay at a rate of once per 5 minutes, each decay will reduce the total stack of Level Shifts by 1.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: The Labyrinth's Level Shifts stack up to a max of 10!
changes.text: Players are given two pop-tray powers while in the labyrinth to assist them:

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: The Labyrinth's Level Shifts stack up to a max of 10!
changes.text: Escape From Fog: Teleports yourself back to the entrance lobby of the labyrinth. 1 second cool-down.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.subsection: The Labyrinth's Level Shifts stack up to a max of 10!
changes.text: Follow Through Fog: Teleport yourself to a target Team or League mate. May fail if the target does not have space nearby or is going through a door. Intended to help teams stick together. 1 second cool-down.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Throughout the colored floors, players can encounter Gladiators In The Fog.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Standing next to one will prompt the Gladiator to respond.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Depending on how many badges from the Labyrinth you currently have, the Gladiator will do one of the following:

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Respond with hints/tips/lore dialog about the Labyrinth.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Gift a Draught of Fog inspiration.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Become hostile and attack the player. (More Labyrinth badges = higher chance of attack)

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Each Gladiator will only interact with the same player once ever.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Defeated Gladiators drop a single Draught of Fog inspiration to one participating player.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: There are many secrets and prizes to be discovered within the Labyrinth of Fog.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Including many not detailed at all in the patch notes!

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Finding a secret area will reward the 'Hidden In Fog' exploration badge.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Secret area doors have a confirmation box when clicked to enter them.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: Some secret areas are easy to find, others more difficult. All secret areas reward the same exploration badge.

changes.category: An Artifact In The Midnighter Club?
changes.text: The secret areas show up as '???' locations and immediately grant the badge upon discovery.

changes.text: Marine Affinity allows players to command the power of the Oceans to buff their friends and wash away their enemies. This set focuses on turning the tides of battle with several area-based buffs and debuffs, specifically bolstering ally damage while dampening enemy damage potential. Thematically, the set's area coverage allows you to either spread out areas of effect in a wide but shallow pool, or dive deep in one spot to bowl over enemies.

'Nutrient-Rich' - Feed Blarf to earn this badge.
'Uncommitted' - Complete 5 Alignment Tip missions to earn this badge.
Alignment Tip mission complete credit is team-wide for all three badges.
'Adept' - Complete 10 Alignment Tip missions to earn this badge.
'Multifaceted' - Complete 25 Alignment Tip missions to earn this badge.
'Slayer of the Minotaur' - Defeat The Minotaur In The Fog to earn this badge.
'Malevolent Intoxication' - Defeat 5 of the Malevolent Fog pinatas to earn this badge.
'Phantom Gladiator' - Defeat 25 Gladiators In The Fog to earn this badge.
'Hidden In Fog' - Locate any of the Labyrinth of Fog's secret areas to earn this badge.
'Lab Rat' - Cross the maze found in the Endless Colonnade to earn this badge.
'Greek Philosopher' - Discover all five history plaques found in the Core of the Labyrinth to earn this badge.
'Arachnos Official / Arachnos Traitor' - Fixed this badge using the hero version text when on a villain character.
'Mythical' - Incarnate Nictus Minotaurs and The Minotaur In The Fog now also count for this badge.
'Gear Smasher' - Psychic Clockwork Gears now count for this badge.

Fixed Welding Ray not using minimum animation time of 3.83s.

Fixed all versions of Energy Aura - Entropy Shield rooting when activated (note: NOT Entropic Aura, which IS enemy affecting).

Fixed some critter cone powers not using same value for range and radius.
Fixed some endurance costs and defense type checks.
Remove /emailsend, /emailsendattachment, /gmailclaim, and /gmailreturn slash commands.

These commands were intended for internal use by the UI and correct usage depends on knowing internal character state that is not visible to the player. Incorrect usage can leave the player's mailbox in a corrupt state that renders it unusable without manual administrator intervention to fix the database records.
